title: Scientists find a surprising genetic twist behind octopus intelligence
caption:
Octopuses and squid have some of the smartest nervous systems on Earth. New research suggests the secret isn't just their genes, but how their DNA is folded in 3D space.

Source: Sciencedaily - Scientists find a surprising genetic twist behind octopus intelligence
